topic.title: Forbes' top fifty creators earned about a billion dollars in a year, and MrBeast alone took close to a third of it

title: MrBeast made $300M in one year. IShowSpeed made $30M
description:
How did MrBeast end up with 29% of everything Forbes' top creators earned?
MrBeast made an estimated $300M, Forbes says, out of $1.02B for its top creators list. Here's how far behind everyone else is.
#MrBeast
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Who would you pay to watch? Comment

lines.text: MrBeast made $300M in one year, Forbes estimates.
Forbes' top creators made $1.02B in all.
So how far behind is everyone else? The streamer IShowSpeed made $30M.
Markiplier, the gamer, made $38M. Rhett and Link, $37M.
Podcaster Steven Bartlett, $52M. Dhar Mann, $65M. Enough to catch him?
All five together still come up short of MrBeast alone.
MrBeast took 29% of the whole list's money. Who would you pay to watch?

Beat 'promise' says 'His whole list made $1.02B.' Right after 'MrBeast made $300M in one year, Forbes estimates.', 'His' refers to MrBeast, the subject of the hook, so a viewer hears that MrBeast's list made $1.02B. That is false: $1.02B is the combined estimate for the 50 creators on Forbes' Top Creators 2026 list (forbes.com.au, Tubefilter). Name the list, e.g. 'Forbes' top fifty creators made {top_whole} in all.' (the previous wording passed). The facts themselves are unchanged and still confirmed.
